reviews.text: I get frustrated sometimes with the lines getting crossed with communication at the front but everyone is nice up there and patient. I love what Dr. Cross has done for our oldest. He has degenerative disc and the acupuncture she has done has added years and quality to his life. We just picked them up from boarding and they are happy and well cared for ☺️

I took our cat for a first appointment today and we had such a great visit. We recently moved to the neighborhood and I am happy to have found this office. Everyone was so kind, professional and extremely knowledgeable.

I wonder if the positive reviews here are from their longer term clients, because they seem to actively not want new ones.
Setting up a new client appointment was easy enough. My 7-month old kitten needed booster and an evaluation for potential neutering complications/cryptorchidism. When we arrived, but before anyone even looked at him, the front desk and intake staff asked for my consent to run a routine (but expensive) battery of blood tests in preparation for surgery. I explained I'd rather wait for the doctor's evaluation and a price quote. They insisted it was required for surgery anyway, so I may as well. I disagreed, so maybe that's why the subsequent events happened as they did.

The tech was great - she was friendly with my boy and understood my concerns. That's pretty much where the positives end. Getting answers from the doctor was like pulling teeth. The first bit of interaction went along the lines of:
"kitten has been seen for this problem before and we were advised to wait and see when he'd be ready to neuter. Does it seem he is now?"
*doctor looks and feels around*
"hmm, yep - he's not descended."
"ok...so what does that mean? does he not need to be neutered after all?"
"sure, i think he can be."
"ok then...should he be? should i wait longer? is it a special surgery?"
"eh, if you want. and yeah, it's cryptorchid."
Cue several more iterations of digging for information from an incredibly indifferent messenger. When I described some other observations and asked if the condition was causing kitten any pain or discomfort, he just shrugged and said "nah, I don't think so." What??

Once the interrogation ended, I was told I'd receive a surgery quote. At the front desk, they asked once again if I wanted the blood panel, and also to schedule surgery. I said I was waiting on the price quote before agreeing to surgery. She just said, "oh." And went back to her computer screen.
"Sooo...when can I expect to get it?"
"They'll email it to you."
Oh, ok.
The weird silent pause that followed said it was time to let myself out. A day later I got an automated follow-up "how is your pet doing" text, which invited a response for questions/concerns. I responded over the text that I never received a quote. Instead of a normal human response, they left me on read and just sent a blank, body-less message with a pdf of the quote attached.

The cherry on top is that they quoted nearly $1k more than our home/primary vet. If my baby really does need an expensive surgery, so be it, but we'll get it done where at the very least the staff doesn't hate us.
Great service and excellent customer support. The girls up front were very welcoming and techs are well educated and knowledgeable. Definitely recommend to all!!!
This place is amazing!

I absolutely love this vet office! The quality of care and attentiveness is unmatched by any other vet i have ever visited. They are exceptionally considerate and extremely fair with pricing.  I love how thorough they are with my babies and how they will answer every single question, no matter how mundane.  I consider myself lucky to be able to call these guys my vets, not the other way around.
Boarded 2 cats here for 6 days. They came home with no signs of trauma like they did in the past when they had been boarded elsewhere. I regard this as a good sign that they had been happy.

Vet refused to speak with me and the staff at the front desk couldn't answer basic questions about the treatment or care for my pet. They perform non-emergency services without asking permission then try to charge an outrageous amount of money for it. I've visited twice thinking the first time was a fluke...nope. That's just how this place is run.

No better vet than Dr Cross! She’s kind and lovely, thorough, and devotes so much time and care to our dog. Dr Tomasini is great too as is her entire team. We switched from a vet up the street a few years ago and couldn’t be happier with our choice.

Update: Dr. Tomasini really helped us through a difficult decision regarding a procedure and even helped to navigate our pet insurance. They worked with us on the large cost and listened to our concerns every step of the way. They even worked through their phone and Internet service being down the day of and didn't miss a beat. We're so happy to have found such a great vet in the area.

Always a good experience here. They've taken care of our senior dogs for years and are quick to respond. They truly make us feel like they care about our pets as much as we do.

Switched to Olmos Park Animal Hospital from PETCO VETCO. The staff were great! Lots of help setting up my Goldendoodle for an account. The wait was short and the Doctor was very attentive to me and my particulary pushy (love me now!) doodle…
Would definitely recommend this facility!
I can not brag enough about this Clinic. All staff members and DVM Tomasini are great at helping both pet and parent 💕 10/10 …

Top notch service at the front desk and a very knowledgeable doctor with a logical approach for remedies.  They provided us quality options for care to help us make the right decision for our pet. The staff was caring and kind and the doctor was very responsive.  Highly recommend.

Olmos Park Vet Hospital was amazing!!!  My husband accidentally gave the wrong heart warm preventative to the wrong dog.  Fear that this could have short term/long term consequences, we tried to rush to our regular vet. We'll, they were closed on the 26th of December and we literally just continued on the same road and found Olmos Park Vet Hospital.  They took us right in and we only had to wait 30 minutes to be seen.  The Vet Tech Alissa was great, she reassured us that our Chihuahua would be well taken care of.  The Vet was also amazing, with her experience and some research she treated our baby very quickly due to small window of treatment that she quickly recognized.  We would highly recommend Olmos Park Vet Hospital to anyone.  Much love and respect from Lulu and family.
Everyone here is always excited to see my pet. Love the friendly and welcoming atmosphere for both of us. They always take excellent care of her.
The staff is very professional and courteous. They make sure the pets they see are well taken care of and in good hands. Anybody who needs a vet, this is the place to go!
Great place and great staff!
The best! Friendly, knowledgeable staff!
We are new to the area and the Olmos Park Animal Hospital was recommended by a friend. Dr. Cross took great care of my fur baby and the entire staff was very friendly and helpful. Highly recommend!

Dr Cross and Dr T have cared for many precious animals over the years and always taken care of us.  Her staff is amazing and always ready to help.  Costs and alternatives have always been explained clearly to me and I cannot recommend a better vet.  We recently lost a pet due to a bad accident and every single person in her office was compassionate and caring to us while going through that difficult time they treat you like family.

I am beyond grateful to have found this amazing vet clinic! They recently took care of both my cat and dog, and the level of care and compassion they showed was simply outstanding. From the moment we walked in, the staff was welcoming, professional, and genuinely interested in getting to know each of my pets and their unique needs.

Both my dog and cat received thorough exams, and the vet took the time to explain each step of their treatments, giving me peace of mind. They handled my dog with so much gentleness, which is not always easy, and managed to keep my skittish cat calm too. I especially appreciated how they followed up with me to check on both of them afterward, which shows their dedication goes far beyond just a quick visit.

The clinic is clean, well-organized, and equipped with the latest technology, which really makes a difference in the quality of care. I felt like both of my pets were treated like family. I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a vet that goes above and beyond!

I can't say enough good things about this clinic! From the moment we walked in, I felt confident and reassured that my pet was in the best possible hands. The entire staff is friendly, attentive, and truly cares about the animals they treat. The veterinarians are highly skilled, taking the time to thoroughly explain every procedure and answer all my questions without ever making me feel rushed.

The facility itself is spotless, with state-of-the-art equipment and a comfortable atmosphere. Even my normally anxious pet seemed at ease! I was also impressed by their reasonable prices and willingness to work within my budget without compromising care quality. I left knowing my pet received exceptional treatment, and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with their health.

If you’re looking for a vet that combines expertise with genuine compassion, look no further.

Been coming here about 6 years, unfortunately had a bad experience today. My dog was over-prescribed medication because his weight was not correctly checked, which is completely fine, that happens. I was also sold a flea preventative that was more expensive than I thought it would be (and too expensive for me). I also purchased heartworm preventatives for my dogs. Once I got home and noticed the two things, i drove back to return them. The receptionist decided to "refund" the entire order to my card, including the heartworm meds (i will receive the refund sometime in the future but not today), and then re-bill me for the heartworm meds and the visit. The problem is, i don't have enough money in my account to cover the initial charge, plus an extra $250 for the heartworm again. The receptionist did not properly set my expectations for this transaction, misled me about how fast the refund would take, and i was left unable to pay for the heartworm medicine (again), to which the receptionist responded "So do you just want to pay for the visit, then?" And fortunately I had enough money to cover an extra $75 for the exam but that was it, no heartworm meds. I was visibly frustrated, then the receptionist asked If I wanted her "to make a note on my account so they discuss the prices next time". This is an unacceptable response from ANY customer service individual. Why do they NOT share with you the prices before ringing you up? Is this company policy, that they have to specially mark someones account in order to share their prices with customers? I'd like to know, honestly. I also had to specifically ask for a printed receipt for my records, which I don't recall having to do before here. And the receipt was put in my bag, after i made the purchase. I didnt even see it until I got home. I am inclined to believe this was all an honest mistake, and at best a teaching moment for staff on how to set expectations, and frankly how to take responsibility when an employee makes an error. However, when I was overcharged, had to ask for a printed receipt, and told i needed to make a special request on my account to have an itemized breakdown of the costs? It does not feel good at all. And i have no heartworm meds, i have to wait until my money is refunded to buy them. Like i began with, i have come to this clinic a while but really debating if i will return. So if you go here, you have to ask for an itemized breakdown before you pay because they won't volunteer it.
